name: Formal
all_locations: San Francisco, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA
long_description: Formal lets your company put AI agents to work on sensitive data without losing control. It sees every connection your people and agents make, whether they run on endpoints or in the cloud, and understands exactly what each one is doing, down to the individual network call. It identifies every agent and the person behind it and enforces least privilege on each request, all from a single control plane, with no change to how anyone works. Credentials never reach agents, private data is masked before it leaves, and risky actions are stopped before they happen. Every session is recorded and replayable. Say yes to the business without saying yes to risk.
one_liner: Least privilege for agents and humans

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
At 17, Mokhtar Bacha became the youngest employee at ConsenSys, hired by Ethereum co-founder Joseph Lubin. There, he gained expertise in cryptography, consensus algorithms, and distributed systems.

Mokhtar launched Formal in 2023 with the mission of enabling true least privilege. Today, thanks to an incredible team, Formal is proud to secure customers like Notion, Lovable, and Decagon.
